text:
Sarah L: Heads up — ACME asked for a precise egress allowlist for our Dedicated nodes in us-west-2. They need a list to give to their security team by EOD.
Devon: Quick summary: two recommended approaches — 1) customer allows a small set of static IPs we can provision (enterprise only), or 2) customer sends traffic through their corporate proxy + allow hostnames.
Priya (Support): Customer currently blocks everything except specific IP ranges. They explicitly said they won't allow wildcard hostnames.
Jake N: Notes from network: our hosted autoscaling fleet uses ephemeral NATs unless we reserve EIPs. For Dedicated we *can* reserve static egress IPs but it requires a contract + provisioning lead time (1-2 weeks).
Maria - Network: For their firewall rules the minimum we need is outbound TCP 443 to these hostnames (SNI required):
  - egress-us-west.redwood-inference.com
  - model-api-us-west.redwood-inference.com
  - embeddings-us-west.redwood-inference.com
  (We recommend hostname allowlist over IPs because downstream infra and autoscaling swap IPs frequently.)
Priya (Support): They said TLS inspection is mandatory in their org — will that break anything?
Devon: If they do TLS MITM, two issues: 1) cert pinning on our SDKs may fail for some flows; 2) streaming/resumable connections may be affected. Option: they can configure their proxy to do passthrough for our hostnames or add our CA to the proxy. Otherwise, Dedicated + private deployment is recommended.
Sarah L: What's the short list we can give them today to unblock the security team?
Jake N: If they absolutely require IPs, we can provide the current NAT pool snapshot (subject to change). Recommend they allow these CIDRs temporarily and review after we provision static EIPs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24. (Mark as temporary!)
Maria - Network: Also ask them to allow outbound DNS to resolver IPs they control or to our DNS (port 53 UDP/TCP) only if they block DNS — but we prefer not to rely on that.
Priya (Support): Can we provide a quick test they can run to confirm egress works?
Devon: Yep — ask them to run these from a workstation behind their firewall/proxy:
```
# test direct TLS connectivity (port 443)
curl -vI https://egress-us-west.redwood-inference.com/health
# test through proxy (HTTP_PROXY env)
HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp.example:8080 curl -vI https://egress-us-west.redwood-inference.com/health
```
Sarah L: Also include guidance for their infra team if they want a proxy-only approach.
Devon: Docs snippet we can paste: "If using a corporate outbound proxy, configure it to allow CONNECT to the hostnames above on port 443. Ensure the proxy does not terminate TLS for these hosts (or add our CA to the proxy). For persistent streaming connections allow longer timeouts (120s+)."
Priya (Support): Customer asked about non-HTTPS ports — do we need 80/443 only?
Jake N: Only 443 outbound is required for API requests. No SSH/RDP ports. Health checks are over HTTPS as well.
Maria - Network: Region note: if they have a gateway that restricts by region, call out us-west-2 for now — we can provide equivalents for eu-west-1/ap-southeast on request.
Sarah L: Process note: if they want static IPs we'll need a support+sales escalation to get EIPs reserved and a security addendum signed. Priya, can you open the ticket?
Priya (Support): On it — creating ticket now and flagging for sales.
ops-bot: deployment: we pushed a temporary allowlist endpoint to staging: https://staging-egress.redwood-inference.com/health
Devon: Final checklist to give customer today: 1) allow outbound TCP 443 to the three hostnames above (or provision static IPs as temporary CIDRs listed), 2) if TLS inspection is enforced, either enable passthrough for these hostnames or add our CA to their proxy, 3) ensure streaming timeout >=120s, 4) confirm region (us-west-2) or request other regions.
Sarah L: I'll draft the note and paste into the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya (Support): Ticket created: #INC-5421 — linking to this thread.
Maria - Network: ping me if they ask for ASN or provider specifics.
Devon: If anyone needs the exact NAT snapshot for staging/prod I'm attaching it to the ticket.
Sarah L: Closing loop — we'll update the customer once sales confirms EIP procurement timeline.
